decisions.statement: Every track filed is read, not only the tracks a sweep files.
A track is matched under the artist the release carrying it names.
A track already naming the song matched is left as that track is.
A track naming a song no longer matched gives that song up.
A track whose song cannot be filed is counted and left as that track is.
Every track changed lands as a single commit or does not land.
Nothing here reaches Spotify or MusicBrainz.
A release filed under a collection that is no artist names no artist.
A track matching no song has that song filed and then names it.
A run stopped at its limit reports the tracks that run read rather than every track filed.

definition: the command naming on every track the song that track is a recording of
